entityDescription:
TSS company operate in thermal spray coatings field, in Italy since 2011.
TSS capability is related to all technologies of thermal spray and more underlined, concerns Metallization, Plasma and HVOF (high velocity oxy fuel) coatings. The three technologies can perform coatings of all kind of powders on the market, such as WC (tungsten carbide); CrC (chromium carbide); Ni (nikel) base metallic; Co (cobalt) base metallic; all grades of stellites; Cr2O3 (chromium oxide); ZrO (zirconia); Al2O3 (alumina); TiO2 (Titanium oxide); Cu (copper) etc.
Thermal spray coatings have a wide range of applications from aeronautical field to oil & gas, as well as glass and paper production, or aluminum lamination. Furthermore to standard applications, thermal spray coatings are used for many other purposes such as dimensional restore of worn parts, thermal insulations, electrical insulations, anti wearing of rotating parts.
TSS is involved in all the above fields and mainly is specialist of manufacturing of plungers of alternative pumps and mechanical seals of centrifugal pumps, being the principal producer of such items in Italy, for the most important pump manufacturers such as Peroni Pompe SpA and Floserve – Wortinghton Italy.
A deep experience has been developed in the coating of turbine parts (blades and vanes) as well as for aeronautical section as for oil & gas field. Important customers such as Alitalia, Fincantieri, Nuovo Pignone-GE, Ansaldo and CIRA (Centro Italiano Ricerche Aerospaziali) have used and/or use services of the Group.
TSS has also a special skill to develop new application or new solution for any kind of industrial problems solvable with thermal spray coatings. To support these activities, the Group has one of the most complete laboratory to perform all kind of tests needed to set and check performance of coatings.
TSS is located in Cassino I.Z. Italy, at 300 mt from the exit of Cassino on the main Italian high way A1, that connect Milan to Naples, and just in the middle between Rome and Naples.
The production is performed in an industrial building of 1000 sqm with the support of 600 smq of technical and administrative offices.
The industrial capability is supported by:- Metallization, Plasma and HVOF full automatic equipments of last generations, operating in cabins capable of parts till 5000 kg of weight and 2000x2000x1000 mm of dimension.
- A complete mechanical department with lathes and grinding machines for the manufacturing of plungers and rotating mechanical seals.
- A laboratory that can perform test also for aeronautical field.
TSS has many certifications and qualification of the major companies operating in all the above fields mentioned.
TSS is also partner of the University of Naples for research and development of new coatings and new application.

entityDescription:
CARTIF is a horizontal, private and non-profit technology center. Its mission is to offer innovative solutions to companies to improve their processes, systems and products, improving their competitiveness and creating new business opportunities. CARTIF develops R&D projects, directly funded by companies or public funds raised through competitive calls for national and international level. CARTIF also advises public authorities (municipalities and regional governments) in the planning and development of innovative projects with high economic returns. The Center maintains the same values and objectives since its foundation in 1994, priority is placed on contributing to the development of its social and economic environment through the use and encouragement of technological innovation via the development and diffusion of research. Its disciplinary teams work in five areas of knowledge that correspond to different economic and technological sectors: industry, energy and environment, construction and infrastructures, agrofood and health and quality of life. Supporting this structure, there are laboratories that have emerged from several lines of research: Analysis and Tests, 3D Scanning, Characterization of biomass, Biotechnology and Materials. Complementing these, other technological services such as management of innovation and technology transfer intended to increase the level of business innovation, better organize their R&D and reap greater benefits from the ideas generated.

The Management Struture of Cartif is divided as follows:
The Board is constituted by 19 companies and institutions. There is a permanent Executive Committee composed by the University of Valladolid, ten associated companies that alternate periodically, and two science and technology research advisors appointed by the General Assembly. Dr. Jose R. Peran Gonzalez has been CARTIF CEO since its foundation. He is emeritus professor at Valladolid University, where he managed the Department of Systems Engineering and Automatics.
Dr. Peran's education (he has a PhD in Industrial Engineering and in Physical Science, and is an Economics graduate) has allowed him to work for thirty years in the private sector -he was head of the bodyworks and mechanics factory and Industrial Director of Renault- and to hold outstanding academic positions. Throughout his vast career, he has developed and coordinated more than 100 R&D projects in Spain and abroad, and has published more than 100 articles, books and book chapters. He is a member of the IEEE, in which he belongs to 14 societies of the Automatics Spanish Committee CEA-IFAC and the Royal Spanish Society of Physics.
The institution itself count with several horizontal Departments which are the following: Management, Business Development, Project Management and R&D Programmes. 
Finally, Cartif is divided into 3 Divisions which covers the different fields od specialization of the Center. They are the following: Energy, Food and Processes and Industrial and Digital Systems. Each of this Divions are divided at the same time on different departments covering diferent fileds of each topic.

INTA has test facilities throughout the Spanish geography, being located its Headquarters in Torrejón de Ardoz (Madrid). Due to its specialization, INTA works on very diverse projects framed within its strategic lines and objectives, developing its own prototypes (full TRL range). In addition, INTA collaborates in programs, projects and actions with companies, organizations, universities and technology centers, both in Spain and outside its borders.
Apart from the technological support to its customers or partners, INTA has a long tradition in R&D&I in space projects and scientific developments. INTA manages its own budget for space projects and the main action lines in this domain are related to design, development, integration, verification and testing of small and medium-sized platforms and payloads (mainly composed of technologies developed in-house or in cooperation with the space industry and academia), ground segment and satellite tracking and operations.

Terranea is a German SME specialised in the development of location-based services and spatial innovation. Based on a wide scientific expertise, the company offers creative solutions fusing data from complementing spatial and non-spatial sources. Open government data, social media, new low-cost sensors and satellites offer a variety and large amounts of data. To determine meaningful information from this data jungle, Terranea applies traditional mapping and geospatial analysis techniques as well as advanced big data analytics and artificial intelligence algorithms. The team is also experienced in developing state-of-the-art geo-ICT tools and apps for solving day to day challenges of individuals but also sophisticated decision support systems for large organizations. 
Besides technical developments the team is consulting clients in the fields of Earth observation and especially Copernicus.
Since its establishment in 2012, Terranea successfully implemented projects for the EC, ESA, EEA, ECMWF, the German Environment Ministry and Environment Agency and the private industry.

High Altitude Pseudo-Satellites (HAPS) are unmanned aerial vehicles deployed at an altitude around 20 Km with the objective of keeping a fixed position to provide communications or remote sensing services to a specific area of interest. These platforms can provide real time services, very high persistence (during weeks or months) and very low latency to an area of interest. In addition, they can be periodically recovered on ground for maintenance, repair and updating activities.

smartHAPS provides environmental monitoring and other remote sensing services of regions, urban and coastal areas during weeks or months. The identification and location of pollution sources and waste dumping, the characterization and monitoring of large agrarian production areas, or maritime areas are current challenges for institutional and commercial customers. SmartHAPS systems deliver a continuous operation over an area of interest with very high spatial, and spectral resolutions and very low information latencies. In addition, they can be recovered on ground and re-launched to the same or alternative locations.
The company is developing its own stratospheric platform, a compact solar powered lighter-than-air-system, based on its team's 15-year experience in the small satellites, and Unmanned Aerial and Surface Vehicles. The use of space proven components and subsystems is enabling an accelerated development of the smartHAPS platform at a lower cost.
